$schema_note: REKA design tokens, taken from the live reka.re site (reka-site-full.html) and the Seth Linton character reference on 10 October 2026. Keep tokens.css in step.

orange.use: REKA orange: the mark, primary accents, CTAs, the orange gradient

orange-deep.use: Second stop of the orange gradient; hover

orange-alt.use: Warm accent used for one of the four ways

blue.use: Links and info accents on dark

orange.use: Hero accents, key CTAs, product-page highlights. A little goes a long way.

orange-rule.value: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in oklch, #FB9800 70%, transparent), transparent)

mono.use: Labels, data, code, the // section markers; used heavily on reka.re

radius.note: REKA is sharp: near-square corners, unlike AntaraX's rounded cards.

motif.section-marker: // lowercase mono label, e.g. '// how it works'
motif.grid: engineering grid lines and blueprint drawings at very low contrast
